text: Yee FDTD: foundations and verified examples The Yee method advances Maxwell equations with staggered electric and magnetic fields. Start with the basic equations, then select a verification example. The latest r6 addition covers one-dimensional lossy and Lorentz-dispersive media. Basic model · Loss and dispersion · Fresnel interfaces · Side/corner PML · Oblique incidence · p polarization, Brewster and TIR This original educational implementation evolves 2D TMz fields (Ez, Hx, Hy) with original vacuum cases in dimensionless homogeneous vacuum without current or charge sources. The original periodic plane waves and rectangular perfect-electric-conductor (PEC) cavity are compared with continuum analytic solutions. Grid refinement, numerical dispersion, a discrete invariant and an approximation to physical energy are measured separately.
